name: How long does a bathroom tile and stone installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom tile and stone installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom tile installation typically takes between three to seven working days, depending on the scope. A simple floor retile might take two to three days, while a full walk-in shower with floor-to-ceiling wall tile, accent niches, and waterproofing takes longer. The timeline includes removing old surfaces, repairing or replacing drywall and backer boards, applying waterproofing membranes, setting the tile, allowing thin-set mortar to cure, and finishing with grout and caulk. Curing times between steps cannot be rushed if you want to prevent moisture leaks and loose tiles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most bathroom tile installations take three to seven days, depending on whether the project is a simple floor update or a full, waterproofed walk-in shower surround.
